name: Require Fields
description: Are these fields present and non-empty on a record? fields is a list or a comma-separated text; answers { valid } or { valid: false, reason, missing } naming what is missing — a form before it is saved, a row before it is imported, a request before it is processed.

data.assignments: [{"variable":"result","value":"{{= (() => { const keys = Array.isArray(fields) ? fields : String(fields ?? '').split(',').map((f) => f.trim()).filter(Boolean); const missing = keys.filter((k) => record == null || record[k] == null || String(record[k]).trim() === ''); return missing.length ? { valid: false, reason: 'Missing: ' + missing.join(', '), missing } : { valid: true }; })() }}"}]
